receipts.detail: Genuine red failures captured on lab fleet before repairs: lab/pkg9-red-1 (fd3b9aee766b3d99027c5a16f70a8a7698c729ff, 5/5 subtests failed), lab/pkg9-opening-red (2fb745967e571a8b379fada4e0cf5612a9217ea8, opening readerDb remained open on retirement), and lab/pkg9-timer-red (2c878cc5d93a3fc3cf4ca8fa001a9c2976378dc3, idle reaper timer failed to arm on failed first acquisition).

Paused reader across PartitionService shutdown, store/storageIncarnationId/checkpointGeneration bump, and same-path reopen rejects READ_VIEW_LOST; removeReplicaStorageArtifacts and requestSnapshotInstall refuse while active or unclosed readers pin dbPath; opening-window retirement closes or retains unclosed custody (lab/pkg9-opening-green-2, lab/pkg9-timer-green).

Injected closeReader failure retains unclosedViews and CUSTODY_REGISTRY (CLOSING_FAILED) slot/byte accounting, fences reads (READ_VIEW_LOST), blocks slot reuse and sidecar removal until actual closure, and arms the idle reaper timer even on failed first acquisition (lab/pkg9-timer-green).

readPinnedSnapshotMetadata reads snapshotAppliedIndex, snapshotTerm, and schemaVersion strictly after BEGIN DEFERRED + PIN_WAL_SNAPSHOT_SQL through readerDb, agreeing with rows across concurrent commits at after_open and after_pin; lost custody triggers wholeAttemptDiscard=true.

Real -wal file bytes measured without double-counting shared dbPath files, enforcing maxRetainedWalBytes/maxRetainedBytes/maxRetainedViews, preserving READ_VIEW_EXPIRED across deadlineMs/maxViewAgeMs/maxIdleMs before and after reapExpiredViews (lab/pkg9-green-c1-2), reaping idle views without next-page requests, and plateauing across repeated checkpoint/reopen cycles.

Query read views retain POLICY_DOMAIN.QUERY_READ_VIEW with per_shard_retained_read_view and wholeAttemptDiscard=true while PartitionService.readHydrationImage preserves independent CDC hydration image state/appliedIndex semantics.

Verified red on unpatched/incomplete states (lab/pkg9-red-1, lab/pkg9-opening-red, lab/pkg9-timer-red) and green across all 6 files (289 assertions in lab/pkg9-green-1) plus follow-up lab/pkg9-green-c1-2, lab/pkg9-opening-green-2, and lab/pkg9-timer-green (14 assertions, 0 failures); independent review recorded by subagent:66d31106-656c-4d8d-8501-7cfc26bdd82e with all conditions and follow-up findings resolved.
